newsitem.title: USA: Port of NY and NJ aims to reduce Newark delays.
newsitem.headline: Port of NY and NJ aims to reduce Newark delays.

text.p: The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey has taken steps to alleviate delays and the estimated $1.2 million that airlines at Newark International Airport absorb annually because of approach procedures at nearby Linden Airport, a port authority official said.

The Port has authorized $3 million to enable Linden Airport to make runway, taxiway and equipment improvements which will allow aircraft out of the airport to use a satellite system for its approach procedures.
Delays occur when poor weather at Linden Airport forces pilots to use approach procedures that interfere with Newark.
The Port said that air traffic controllers at Newark are then temporarily forced to stop traffic there to accommodate the Linden pilots. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
